name: ollic-sketch
description: Design and edit buildings in your own Revit and Blender by talking to Claude: architecture, structure, MEP, drawings, renders, walkthrough and construction videos, 3D buyer tours, and a Naira bill of quantities.
long_description: Ollic Sketch connects Claude to the Revit on your computer. Describe what you want in plain language and Claude builds it in your real model: levels, walls, floors, roofs, doors and windows, rooms, columns, beams, foundations, pipes and ducts, clash checks, views, sheets, PDF and image exports, and a priced bill of quantities in Naira. Every change is one undo step in Revit. Requires Revit 2024 or later with the Ollic Sketch helper installed by setup.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Shows which design tools are connected to Ollic Sketch right now (the Revit versions open on this computer).

tools.name: revit_get_project_info
tools.description: Project name, levels with elevations, element counts, active view and selection count.

tools.name: revit_get_selection
tools.description: Details of the elements the architect has selected in Revit (walls with start/end/thickness, doors, rooms and so on).

tools.name: revit_list_elements
tools.description: Lists elements of one category with geometry (walls: start, end, thickness, height; rooms: name, area; doors/windows: host wall, sill).

tools.name: revit_list_types
tools.description: Lists the types loaded in the project for one kind of element, for example the wall types and their thicknesses, or the door families.

tools.name: revit_create_levels
tools.description: Creates levels (storeys) and a floor plan view for each.

tools.name: revit_create_grids
tools.description: Creates structural grid lines.

tools.name: revit_create_walls
tools.description: Creates walls along centre-lines.

tools.name: revit_create_floors
tools.description: Creates floor slabs from boundary points, or from the outline of the walls on a level when no boundary is given.

tools.name: revit_create_roof
tools.description: Creates a roof on a level (usually a 'Roof' level at the top of the walls).

tools.name: revit_place_openings
tools.description: Places doors and windows in walls.

tools.name: revit_create_rooms
tools.description: Places named rooms at points inside enclosed walls, or set auto_level to fill every enclosed space on a level.

tools.name: revit_place_components
tools.description: Places loaded families such as WCs, basins, showers, lights, sockets, distribution boards, AC units and furniture at points.

tools.name: revit_modify_elements
tools.description: Moves, rotates, changes type or thickness, or sets parameters of elements.

tools.name: revit_delete_elements
tools.description: Deletes elements by id.

tools.name: revit_create_columns
tools.description: Places structural columns at points or at every grid intersection, from base_level to top_level (default: the level above).

tools.name: revit_create_beams
tools.description: Places beams between points, or along every wall of a level (ring beams / lintel bands), at a level plus offset.

tools.name: revit_create_foundations
tools.description: Creates strip footings under all walls of a level and/or pad footings at points or under every column.

tools.name: revit_create_pipes
tools.description: Draws pipe runs through points (z = height above the level, mm).

tools.name: revit_create_ducts
tools.description: Draws duct runs through points (z = height above the level, mm), rectangular (width/height) or round (diameter).

tools.name: revit_find_clashes
tools.description: Finds hard clashes, by default pipes and ducts against beams, columns, walls, floors and foundations.

tools.name: revit_create_views
tools.description: Creates floor, ceiling or structural plans, a section between two points, all four elevations, or a 3D view.

tools.name: revit_create_sheets
tools.description: Creates drawing sheets with the project's title block and places the given views on them.

tools.name: revit_open_view
tools.description: Opens a view in Revit so the architect can see the result.

tools.name: revit_export_pdf
tools.description: Exports sheets (default: all sheets) or views to one PDF in Documents\Ollic Sketch\Exports.

tools.name: revit_export_image
tools.description: Exports a realistic, shaded or hidden-line image of a 3D view (creates one if no view_id is given).

tools.name: revit_export_fbx
tools.description: Exports the 3D model to an FBX file for Blender (renders, walkthroughs, construction films, buyer tours).

tools.name: blender_get_scene_info
tools.description: What is in Blender now: size, rooms, objects per construction stage, cameras, time of day and render jobs.

tools.name: blender_build_from_plan
tools.description: Builds a full 3D model in Blender from a dimensioned plan: walls with doors and windows cut in, slabs, floor finishes, ceilings, stairs, roof with gable walls, foundations, site and simple furniture per room.

tools.name: blender_import_model
tools.description: Imports a model file (FBX from revit_export_fbx, or glTF/OBJ).

tools.name: blender_apply_style
tools.description: Sets the look: clay (plain grey, the guide for AI video) or realistic materials.

tools.name: blender_set_time_of_day
tools.description: Moves the sun for the hour (6 morning to 22 night); evening and night switch on room lights.

tools.name: blender_set_camera_path
tools.description: Sets the walkthrough route at eye height.

tools.name: blender_render_video
tools.description: Starts rendering a video in the background: kind walkthrough (along the camera path) or construction (foundation to furnished, orbiting camera).

tools.name: blender_render_status
tools.description: Progress of render jobs: frames done, minutes left, and the video file when finished.

tools.name: blender_cancel_render
tools.description: Stops a render job.

tools.name: blender_render_still
tools.description: Renders one image: exterior (three-quarter view), aerial, or walk (a frame of the walkthrough).

tools.name: blender_export_tour
tools.description: Exports a 3D buyer tour: one HTML file that opens on any phone or computer, with a guided tour (room name, size, selling point), free walking, dollhouse view with the roof off, time-of-day slider and soft music.

tools.name: blender_save
tools.description: Saves the Blender file.

tools.name: revit_get_quantities
tools.description: Measured quantities from the model: wall areas by thickness, slab, roof, column, beam and footing volumes, door and window counts, pipe and duct lengths, room areas.

tools.name: ollic_bill_of_quantities
tools.description: Builds a priced bill of quantities in Naira from the Revit model, using the architect's saved rates.

tools.name: ollic_rates
tools.description: Shows the Naira rates used for the bill of quantities, or updates some of them (give rate keys and new values).
